title: Code 430 district border v0
description: Optional file in a map pack whose district has a border on its city's chunk grid (add-district-stitching). The importer cuts the road graph at the border; each road that leaves the district ends on a border line at a dead-end node, listed here as a crossing so the game can join it to the matching crossing of the neighbouring district. Local metres, x east, z south.

chunks.description: The border in chunks, [x0, z0, x1, z1] (x0..x1-1, z0..z1-1), as in pack.json map.border.

rect.description: The border in metres, [x0, z0, x1, z1].

edge.description: The road graph edge that ends here.

node.description: Its dead-end node on the border line.

heading.description: Unit (x, z) along the road, pointing out of the district.
